title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Outreach Optimization Agent picks email send times
summary: The briefing passes: its enablement requirements, consumption billing, roadmap targets and automation calls are supported by current Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should complete three control paths and remove a monitoring checklist instruction that has no corresponding control row.

claims.claim: Outreach Optimization Agent is an AI journey step in Customer Insights - Journeys that chooses marketing email send times.
claims.quote: Outreach Optimization Agent is an AI-powered journey step in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys that optimizes when your marketing emails are sent.

claims.claim: The agent chooses message cadence as well as send times.
claims.quote: Instead of relying on fixed schedules, the agent dynamically determines optimal send times and cadence, helping ensure that outreach is delivered when customers are more likely to engage.
